firstRun.alphaBody: Godwake is in early alpha — expect rough edges and frequent changes. Spot a bug or have an idea? Tap the ✎ Feedback button (top-right) any time — we read every note.
firstRun.alphaBodyNoFeedback: Godwake is in early alpha — expect rough edges and frequent changes. Thank you for braving it this early.

title.tagline: The soul remembers. The flesh forgets.
title.subtitle: A roguelite of borrowed lives
title.srdAttribution: Includes material from the System Reference Document 5.1 by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available under CC-BY-4.0
title.confirmNewBody: Your soul — {soul} — will be released back to the wheel.
title.confirmNewNote: Manual save slots are not touched. Only the active autosave is wiped.

settings.title: Settings
settings.musicHint: Music is muted by default. Drag the slider up to wake the ambient bed.
settings.speedLockedHint: ×2 and ×4 are sold at the Druid Grove — The Wheel, Quickened and The Wheel, Unbound.
settings.turnEndHint: Delay before your turn auto-ends when no actions remain. Lower = snappier.
settings.languageHint: The words of the world bend to the tongue you choose. Your choice is remembered.
settings.saveSlotsHint: Slot 0 is the autosave — written on every change. Slots 1 and 2 are manual backups.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete slot {n}? This cannot be undone.
settings.importPlaceholder: Paste the JSON copied from Export here…

postmortem.diedWithNote: These could have helped. The soul remembers.

summary.deepens: The world deepens. Ascension {n} opens to you — a harder road, and a richer one. The Grove stirs with it.
summary.groveReturns: The grove will return you to life. Your soul remembers what your flesh has forgotten.
summary.renownLedger: {mobs} foes felled · {bosses} bosses broken · {rooms} rooms walked — {base} weight × {mult} of the soul

level.asiHint: +2 to one ability, or +1 to two — but a score already at 18+ costs 2 per point. ({spent}/{budget} spent)
level.archetypeHint: A lasting path — it shapes which gear and playstyle reward you. This choice sticks for the run.
level.leanContrast: One of these roads walks with steel, the other with the working — they play out very differently.
level.slotOpens: Your first level-{n} slot opens — a working to fill it.

shop.subtitle: Merchant · Coin and a charter, no questions asked
shop.boundToReliquary: {name} bound to your reliquary — attune it at the hub.

map.abandonBody: Turn back for Wakeford now. You keep your hide, but the gold and the glory stay buried.
map.sealedHint: ⚿ This road is barred to a soul so young. Walk it once you have earned the mark.
map.hoverHint: The lit paths are open to you. Hover a road, then step.

blurb.combat: A fight on the road. XP and what the dead were carrying.
blurb.elite: A dangerous foe — harder than the road around it, and richer for it.
blurb.boss: The one who holds this chapter. There is no way past but through.
blurb.rest: A safe pause. Bind your wounds before the dark deepens.
blurb.shrine: A god still listens here. A blessing for the asking.
blurb.event: Something waits that is not a fight. Or not only a fight.
blurb.shop: Coin changes hands. Stock yourself before the road runs out.
blurb.treasure: Spoils left unguarded. Take what you can carry.
blurb.camp: A fire on the seam between chapters.

feedback.title: Send Word
feedback.intro: Found something broken, or have an idea? Send it straight to the keeper of this world.
feedback.placeholder: Tell us what happened, or what you'd like to see…
feedback.sent: Sent. Thank you — the keeper hears you.
feedback.error: It didn't get through. Try again in a moment.
